name: Laser Tank
summary: This is a puzzle game. You must get your tank to the flag in every level. Your tank can move in four directions and can fire a laser that is used to move objects. The amount of moves and shots it takes to complete a level are recorded in a high score list. The scores are then compared with the current "Global High Score" file. You can get a current copy of the Global High Score file on LaserTank web site. If you beat one of the scores by making less moves to finish the level, then send me an e-mail with your "LaserTank.hs" file attached. I will update the website with your score; however, you will have to prove your score by recording the level and sending me the playback file [.LPB file]. Also, don't forget to rate the unrated levels you solve. You can use the LaserTank Level's Evaluator tool to do it.
